pipeline._comment: CALIBRATE: camera_name matches supervisor.py's STEERING camera (ASI662MM, CAMERA_CONFIGS index 1). width/height default to 256 (must be a multiple of 8) with start_x/start_y auto-centred; set explicit start_x/start_y once the beam's sensor position is known so the ROI tracks it instead of the raw sensor centre. exposure/gain are ASI SDK defaults (1000 us / 100), not tuned for this beam's brightness.
Raw frame tap for supervisor.py's brightness-hill-climb spiral search (BRIGHTNESS_PORT). A sink only observes/forwards -- center_of_mass below still gets the unmodified frame.
Whole-frame CoM, normalised to [-1, 1]. CALIBRATE threshold against real background/sensor noise (5 is a placeholder). region_height/width must match the camera's width/height above.
CoM telemetry -> supervisor.py TelemetryReceiver (TELEMETRY_PORT). Must precede the udp_source below.
Setpoint / spiral-search commands from supervisor.py CommandSender (COMMAND_PORT). Open-loop: no PID in this pipeline, so this vector goes straight to clamp + the DAC.
Bound the command to the DAC's valid range before it reaches hardware.

Fast steering-mirror DAC (TI DAC81404) over the parallel-port SPI link (devices/parport_dac.c) -- link/pci/bar/offsets/sclk_bit/sdin_bit/sync_bit below are that file's own documented defaults, not guesses. CALIBRATE channel/index/scale/offset/range against the real mirror amplifier: channel 0/1 assumed to be DACA=y, DACB=x; scale/offset/range are the device defaults (1.0 V/unit, 0 V at zero, unipolar 0-10 V) and very likely wrong for this mirror's driver -- verify polarity and range on the bench (DAC output disconnected from the mirror) before connecting it.
